text:
Maria Chen: hey team, spotted a weird 404 when following the 'token caching' link from the onboarding runbook. looks like a redirect loop or a shortlink that stopped resolving. blocks a new hire trying to verify kv-cache steps :grimacing:
Tyler Nguyen: can you drop the exact link and a quick repro? I can try a one-line fix if it's just a bad relative path :+1:
Maria Chen: sure — original: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/onboarding#token-caching -> the href goes to /docs/kv-cache which returns 404 for me. curl output: ```bash
curl -I https://internal.redwood/docs/kv-cache
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Server: nginx
```
Maria Chen: not urgent but it'd be nice to patch before next cohort. tagged the new hire in the onboarding checklist so small UX win if fixed :wave:
Jamie Patel: @Tyler any chance you can claim? might be a frontmatter slug mismatch or an old shortlink. if you can't i'll volunteer to open a quick PR with the redirect rule.
Tyler Nguyen: I can take a look in ~30m. if it's frontmatter i can update the slug and add a redirect in the netlify/_redirects. if it's a shortlink rot we should update the shortlink mapping table in docs-data.json
Maria Chen: thanks — desired canonical target is /runbooks/kv-cache (we intentionally moved runbooks under /runbooks last quarter). the href probably wasn't updated everywhere.
Docs Bot: automated scan note — earlier this morning a crawler flagged 3 dead internal links under /onboarding (ids: 1024, 1027, 1031). filing a follow-up ticket in #docs-sweeps if you want a bulk pass :robot_face:
Tyler Nguyen: quick update — found the anchor used `#token-caching` but the runbook now uses `#token-cache` (tiny rename). pushing a tiny PR that updates the hrefs across onboarding pages and adds a short redirect for the old slug. should be done in the next patch.
Maria Chen: awesome, thank you. can you drop the PR link when ready so i can sanity check the wording for L4 onboarding?
Tyler Nguyen: will do — PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/4821 (small replace + redirect entry).
Jamie Patel: nice. i'll let the new hire know after merge and mark the checklist item done.
Maria Chen: :sparkles: great teamwork. leaving this thread open until green in prod.
Tyler Nguyen: merged and deployed to staging. verifying prod now.
Docs Bot: deploy bot — deployment 2024-05-18T15:28:12Z succeeded for branch docs/kv-cache-fix to prod :white_check_mark:
Tyler Nguyen: prod looks good, link resolves to /runbooks/kv-cache and anchor jumps correctly. closing out.
Maria Chen: closing — thanks all! :tada:
